recommendation: Consider one fixed class-weighted BC method experiment using only the previously sealed training sample, not the failed panel.
basis: Published conditional teacher-label counts are heavily imbalanced; a capped inverse-square-root weight is a fixed hypothesis, not evidence of improved play.
limits: Keep the original model and trainer frozen; one separately registered fit, no selection using consumed holdout outcomes, no failed-panel replay or replacement. New competitive assessment requires newly registered independent seeds. Rare labels remain rare and may overfit.
